Script.name: End-to-End Instrumentation
Script.script:
-- End-to-end instrumentation is loaded last so it can inventory and wrap -- functions from every LuminariGUI subsystem.
function GUI.debugSnapshot(reason) if GUI.DEBUG ~= true then return end
GUI.debug("SNAPSHOT", "BEGIN " .. tostring(reason or "unspecified"))
local environment = { debugEnabled = GUI.DEBUG, GUI = type(GUI), Geyser = type(Geyser), Adjustable = type(Adjustable), CSSMan = type(CSSMan), map = type(map), msdp = type(msdp), demonnic = type(demonnic), chat = type(demonnic and demonnic.chat), initialized = GUI.initialized, }
if type(getMudletVersion) == "function" then local ok, value = pcall(getMudletVersion, "string") environment.mudletVersion = ok and value or ("ERROR: " .. tostring(value)) end if type(getOS) == "function" then local ok, operatingSystem, operatingSystemVersion = pcall(getOS) environment.operatingSystem = ok and (tostring(operatingSystem) .. " " .. tostring(operatingSystemVersion or "")) or ("ERROR: " .. tostring(operatingSystem)) end if type(getPackageInfo) == "function" then local ok, value = pcall(getPackageInfo, "LuminariGUI", "version") environment.packageVersion = ok and value or ("ERROR: " .. tostring(value)) end if type(getConfig) == "function" then local ok, value = pcall(getConfig, "enableMSDP") environment.enableMSDP = ok and value or ("ERROR: " .. tostring(value)) end if type(getMainWindowSize) == "function" then local ok, width, height = pcall(getMainWindowSize) environment.mainWindow = ok and (tostring(width) .. "x" .. tostring(height)) or ("ERROR: " .. tostring(width)) end if type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" then local ok, value = pcall(getMudletHomeDir) environment.profileHome = ok and value or ("ERROR: " .. tostring(value)) end GUI.debug("SNAPSHOT", "environment", environment)
local requiredFunctions = { "GUI.init_background", "GUI.set_borders", "GUI.init_boxes", "GUI.init_gauges", "GUI.init_action_icons", "GUI.tabbedInfoWindow.init", "GUI.init_player", "GUI.init_group", "GUI.Affects.init", "GUI.buttonWindow.init", "GUI.init_castConsole", "GUI.styleScrollbar", "GUI.registerEventHandlers", "GUI.initializeOrRefresh", "GUI.requestMSDPReports", "GUI.onProtocolEnabled", "GUI.AdjustableContainers.init", "map.initialize", "map.eventHandler", "map.onProtocolEnabled", "demonnic.chat.create", "demonnic.chat.append", "demonnicOnStart", } for _, functionPath in ipairs(requiredFunctions) do GUI.debug("SNAPSHOT", "required function " .. functionPath, { status = type(GUI.debugResolve(functionPath)), }) end
GUI.debug("SNAPSHOT", "important runtime objects", { Left = type(GUI.Left), Right = type(GUI.Right), Bottom = type(GUI.Bottom), Box2 = type(GUI.Box2), Health = type(GUI.Health), Moves = type(GUI.Moves), PSP = type(GUI.PSP), Enemy = type(GUI.Enemy), chatContainer = type(GUI.chatContainer), roomInfoContainer = type(GUI.roomInfoContainer), buttonPanelContainer = type(GUI.buttonPanelContainer), actionIconsContainer = type(GUI.actionIconsContainer), mapContainer = type(map and map.container), mapWindow = type(map and map.mapwindow), asciiMapWindow = type(map and map.minimap), })
GUI.debug("SNAPSHOT", "handler and container counts", { eventHandlerIds = GUI.debugCountEntries(GUI.eventHandlerIds), lifecycleHandlerIds = GUI.debugCountEntries(GUI.lifecycleHandlerIds), mapperHandlerIds = GUI.debugCountEntries(map and map.fileScopeHandlerIds), ownedTimerIds = GUI.debugCountEntries(GUI.ownedTimerIds), adjustableContainers = GUI.debugCountEntries( GUI.AdjustableContainers and GUI.AdjustableContainers.containers ), chatTabs = GUI.debugCountEntries(demonnic and demonnic.chat and demonnic.chat.tabs), chatWindows = GUI.debugCountEntries( demonnic and demonnic.chat and demonnic.chat.windows ), })
local home = type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" and getMudletHomeDir():gsub("\\", "/") or "" local assets = { "images/ui_texture.jpg", "images/ui_texture.png", "images/buttons/button.png", "images/action-standard.png", "images/action-standard-50.png", "images/action-move.png", "images/action-move-50.png", "images/action-swift.png", "images/action-swift-50.png", } for _, relativePath in ipairs(assets) do local fullPath = home .. "/LuminariGUI/" .. relativePath local exists = type(io.exists) == "function" and io.exists(fullPath) or false GUI.debug("ASSET", relativePath, {exists = exists, path = fullPath}) end
GUI.debug("MSDP", "variable inventory", { count = GUI.debugCountEntries(msdp), tableType = type(msdp), }) if type(msdp) == "table" then local keys = {} for key in pairs(msdp) do if type(msdp[key]) ~= "function" then keys[#keys + 1] = key end end table.sort(keys, function(left, right) return tostring(left) < tostring(right) end) for _, key in ipairs(keys) do GUI.debug("MSDP", "msdp." .. tostring(key), msdp[key]) end end
GUI.debug("SNAPSHOT", "boot-stage results", GUI.debugBootResults) GUI.debug("SNAPSHOT", "END " .. tostring(reason or "unspecified")) end
local function wrapTableFunctions(owner, tableName, exclusions) if type(owner) ~= "table" then GUI.debug("INSTRUMENT", "table unavailable", tableName) return end
local functionNames = {} for functionName, value in pairs(owner) do if type(value) == "function" and not exclusions[functionName] then functionNames[#functionNames + 1] = functionName end end table.sort(functionNames) for _, functionName in ipairs(functionNames) do GUI.debugWrapFunction( owner, functionName, tableName .. "." .. tostring(functionName) ) end end
local guiExclusions = { debug = true, debugCall = true, debugCountEntries = true, debugError = true, debugResolve = true, debugSnapshot = true, debugValue = true, debugWrap = true, debugWrapFunction = true, }
wrapTableFunctions(GUI, "GUI", guiExclusions) wrapTableFunctions(GUI.Affects, "GUI.Affects", {}) wrapTableFunctions(GUI.tabbedInfoWindow, "GUI.tabbedInfoWindow", {}) wrapTableFunctions(GUI.buttonWindow, "GUI.buttonWindow", {}) wrapTableFunctions(GUI.AdjustableContainers, "GUI.AdjustableContainers", {}) wrapTableFunctions(CSSMan, "CSSMan", {}) wrapTableFunctions(map, "map", {}) wrapTableFunctions(demonnic, "demonnic", {}) -- append() must select/copy the current server line before anything echoes to -- the main console. Its own tail-end diagnostic records the operation safely. wrapTableFunctions(demonnic and demonnic.chat, "demonnic.chat", {append = true})
if type(demonnicChatSwitch) == "function" then demonnicChatSwitch = GUI.debugWrap("YATCO.demonnicChatSwitch", demonnicChatSwitch) end if type(demonnicOnStart) == "function" then demonnicOnStart = GUI.debugWrap("YATCO.demonnicOnStart", demonnicOnStart) end if type(demonnicOnInstall) == "function" then demonnicOnInstall = GUI.debugWrap("YATCO.demonnicOnInstall", demonnicOnInstall) end
GUI.debug("INSTRUMENT", "end-to-end function wrapping complete") GUI.debugCall( "SNAPSHOT/instrumentation load", GUI.debugSnapshot, "instrumentation fragment loaded" )
if type(GUI.setOwnedTimer) == "function" then GUI.setOwnedTimer("debug.instrumentationSnapshot", 2, GUI.debugWrap("SNAPSHOT/instrumentation delayed timer", function() GUI.debugCall( "SNAPSHOT/instrumentation delayed", GUI.debugSnapshot, "two seconds after instrumentation load" ) end)) end
